Home Office No. L. 4050
M.I.5 No. P.F. 49542
Certificate of Naturalization No. AZ 48082

A certificate of naturalization has been granted to
Mr. Ernst Bruno Löwenheim
of 10, Hudson Rd, London, N.4.
and the Oath of Allegiance has been duly taken.

The wife Mrs. Marianne Löwenheim
has made a declaration of acquisition of British nationality and is also now a British subject. She was British before the marriage.

ENCL
hub 8 DEC 1948
TO CIA
REF PF 49542
